question: ABCD is a trapezium in which BC ∥ AD and AC = CD. If ∠ABC = 113° and ∠BAC = 26°, then what is the measure of ∠ACD (in degree)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In ΔABC, sum of angles is 180° ⇒ ∠BCA = 180° − (113° + 26°) = 41°.

Since BC ∥ AD, alternate interior angles are equal ⇒ ∠CAD = ∠BCA = 41°.

In ΔACD, given AC = CD, angles opposite to equal sides are equal ⇒ ∠ADC = ∠CAD = 41°.

In ΔACD, sum of angles is 180° ⇒ ∠ACD = 180° − (41° + 41°) = 98°.

**∴ The correct answer is 98°.**
